description:
On the day of the shoot, Taichi begins to feel like he is really on a date, but at the same time, he begins to have mixed feelings about the fact that she is not his real girlfriend...
Unaware of these feelings, Kanna`s next destination is a love hotel. Ignoring Taichi`s confusion, Kanna gets into a swimsuit, prepares a mat and lotion, and begins preparations for the shoot.\\[i][/i]
Source: hanime.tv

titles.title: 初めての撮影! 初デート!?
